description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: 🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,600+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.
A cross-platform launcher that simply works
Bringing Astrid Tasks back from the dead

All your computers and your phone/iPhone, working as one desk. Screens, apps, files, clipboard, calls, texts, notifications, mouse and keyboard, shared between Mac, Windows, Linux , Android, Web and ios / ipados . Free and open source. No account, no cloud, and no shared network needed.

Win顺：免费开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器。双击 Ctrl，拼音秒搜文件、全文搜索 Word/Excel/PDF、剪贴板历史（代替 Win+V）、对话框搜索、任务栏搜索、插件、AI 助手 MCP。Free Windows search launcher: pinyin file search, full-text search, clipboard history, MCP server. Everything/Listary alternative.
An opinionated personal dashboard for your terminal — world clocks, calendar and agenda, weather, tasks, notes, markets and live system metrics in a tab you leave open all day. Rust + ratatui.
Coco Super Intelligence: agent skills, slash commands and subagents for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. One command installs them into the tool you already use.
Open-source developer productivity dashboard - GitHub stats, PR metrics, streaks & goals.
Note taking and organization; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft OneNote, rebuilt in pure Rust.
Beauty is productivity. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and 40+ more coding agents, side by side in one window.
Forsion is All You Need. A local-first second-brain workbench: your files on one desk, and AI working on it with you.

Native C++20/Rust 13-in-1 Windows suite (~15MB idle, 0 Electron): instant NTFS/app/bookmark/content search (+ 350KB MCP server), persistent clipboard, Text Expander, Listary dialog jump, File Locksmith, 8-lang offline OCR & 1:1 translation, auto-zoom recorder, mouse gestures & <2MB Picasa viewer.
Brushes, panels, and canvas flow tuned for Clip Studio Paint Ex.
Manage Office documents with Dabalor, a Microsoft Office companion tool.
Scribe-Android: Keyboards for language learners & Conjugate-Android: Wikidata based verb conjugation
